newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber futures dip on near-term over supply.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber futures dip on near-term over supply.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures ended sharply lower on Wednesday, as selling gathered force due to near-term oversupply trends, traders said.
Prices ranged from 1.5 yen to 5.2 yen per kg lower. Benchmark September was off 1.5 yen at 139.3 yen.
"Views that deliveries at the spot expiry next week would be large, has circulated in the market, and that stimulated active selling," one analyst at a commodity broker said.
An increase in Japan's rubber stocks as of April 10, was also regarded as a negative factor. "Prices are likely to head down in the near-term," the analyst said.
